title: Start: Pine Script commissions?
detail: Custom TradingView indicators coded to a buyer's rules on Fiverr (Fiverr keeps 20%). Claude writes and tests the code and drafts replies; you own the account, message clients and check deliveries. Realistic first 90 days: $0 to $300 (low to medium confidence). Your time: 3 to 5 hours a week while orders are active.
